title: Enterprise Connectivity: monthly included outbound transfer
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following monthly included outbound transfer for each named contract tier. Internet outbound transfer included per holding per complete month; GB integer.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | monthly included outbound transfer | 1000 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | monthly included outbound transfer | 2500 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | monthly included outbound transfer | 5000 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | monthly included outbound transfer | 10000 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | monthly included outbound transfer | 20000 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | monthly included outbound transfer | 50000 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the monthly included outbound transfer is 1000.
